n1.text:
What changed against today

• 8 tabs → 4 modes: Build · Send · Break · Results
• Ask Claude removed
• Everything on the map is clickable and says so on hover
• Follow panel is always on the right while a message is followed
• One timeline at the bottom: your cuts and repairs are markers on it
• Example numbers on these boards are illustrations, not a run

n2.text:
Round 2

• Nothing from today is dropped: board 8 lists every feature and its new home
• Control room: phones keep running while you cut internet, links or power
• Results: KPIs, charts, post offices, bottlenecks, loss reasons, live log, compare runs
• Light and dark mode on every screen (try the sun/moon button on boards 6 and 7)

n3.text:
Also worth simulating (found in the code)

• Replica post offices: mail copied to several hosts (rendezvous hashing); kill one, the others deliver
• Backbone self-healing: min-peers, DHT peer discovery, seed DNS, reconnect every 5 s
• Phone ↔ radio link drops (Bluetooth/USB); phone as its own host; Wi-Fi vs mobile data (CGNAT)
• Restore a lost device from the recovery phrase
• Attacks: spam (guard bans), forged or replayed alerts (rejected)
• Day/night: people turn radios off, batteries charge
• Calibrate path loss from real range-test results
• Duty-cycle limits per sub-band
